## Problem and use case

Who encounters the problem, and what happens today? Link related issues or existing work.

## Proposed result

Describe the intended behavior, affected products/modules and how success could be checked.

## Alternatives and scope

Explain existing workarounds, important tradeoffs and what is outside this proposal. Identify new dependencies or assets, if needed.

Review is voluntary; a proposal does not promise implementation or acceptance.
